title: Teas Official Random Things
description: Added items from other mods and games: such as GregTech's Vajra.
body:
# Introduction
This mod adds items from other mods or games, such as the Vajra from GregTech and the Horn of Plenty from Terraria.

# How to use?
Just download it and put it into mods folder.

_* Please check the runtime requirements before installation. *_
# Why need this?
This mod adds some end-game tools from the original version, which can be used infinitely (unlimited durability), designed especially for lazy players.

_* Limited to the current version; future versions may add more interesting items. *_


# Runtime Requirements
**Game Version:** 1.21.1

**NeoForge:** ≥21.1.213

# Contact Us
[GitHub](https://github.com/TeasOfficial/TeasOfficial-Random-Things-Mod)

# WARNING
This project created by the author for learning Neoforged development, and it may have bugs or performance issues. You are welcome to provide feedback on GitHub, and other developers are also welcome to submit Pull Requests.

Some items still do not have crafting recipes and can be modified through [KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs).
